summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TPS563208DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6, buck): evaluated 25 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (1 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 5 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 2 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck, synchronous), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOT-23-6.
Re-verify switching frequency (580 kHz), inductor value (2.2 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (0.768 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
